title: Willam disqualified
summary: In Frenemies (US-S04-E08), after Latrice Royale and Willam won the duet challenge, RuPaul revealed Willam had breached contract (inviting her husband to the hotel) and disqualified her — the first disqualification in Drag Race history. Phi Phi O'Hara and Sharon Needles both survived their lip-sync.

title: First deferred live crowning
summary: Season 4 was the first to defer the crown: The Final Three (US-S04-E13) staged a three-way lip-sync to "Glamazon" with no winner announced on set. Sharon Needles was crowned at the live reunion (US-S04-E14), with Chad Michaels and Phi Phi O'Hara as runners-up.

title: Kenya Michaels voted back in
summary: After Kenya Michaels was eliminated in Snatch Game (US-S04-E05), the judges voted her back for DILFs: Dads I'd Like to Frock (US-S04-E10). She was eliminated again that episode after lip-syncing against Latrice Royale.

title: Latrice Royale Miss Congeniality
summary: Latrice Royale was voted Miss Congeniality by viewers, announced at the Season 4 reunion (US-S04-E14) where Sharon Needles was also crowned.
